statement: The complete fixed-shape location set is a singleton above shape one, the median interval at one, or all least-loss sample knots below one.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {ν σ : ℝ} (hν : 0 < ν) (hσ : 0 < σ) (hn : 0 < n) (x : Fin n → ℝ) : let M := {μ | IsMaxOn (fun m ↦ Ged.logLik ν x (m, σ)) univ μ} (1 < ν → ∃ μ, M = {μ}) ∧ (ν = 1 → M = Laplace.medianSet x hn) ∧ (ν < 1 → M = {m | ∃ i, m = x i ∧ ∀ j, Ged.residualSum ν x (x i) ≤ Ged.residualSum ν x (x j)})

statement: Constant samples have no joint maximizer. On nonconstant data the fixed-shape maximizing set is a singleton above one, the median interval at one, or all least-loss sample knots below one, with a common positive fitted scale.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {ν : ℝ} (hν : 0 < ν) (hn : 0 < n) (x : Fin n → ℝ) : (¬ LocationScale.Nonconstant x → Ged.jointMaximizers ν x = ∅) ∧ (LocationScale.Nonconstant x → (1 < ν → ∃ p, Ged.jointMaximizers ν x = {p}) ∧ (ν = 1 → Ged.jointMaximizers ν x = Laplace.medianSet x hn ×ˢ {Real.sqrt 2 * Laplace.meanAbsDev x (Laplace.lowerMedian x hn)}) ∧ (ν < 1 → ∃ s > 0, Ged.jointMaximizers ν x = {m | ∃ i, m = x i ∧ ∀ j, Ged.residualSum ν x (x i) ≤ Ged.residualSum ν x (x j)} ×ˢ {s}))

statement: At fixed mean and sd the high-shape trace has a penalty exp of minus Euler’s constant per contact. Any strictly outside observation makes the trace lose.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {σ : ℝ} (hσ : 0 < σ) (x : Fin n → ℝ) (μ : ℝ) : let ρ := sqrt 3 * σ let k := (Finset.univ.filter fun i ↦ |x i-μ| = ρ).card let f := fun p ↦ Ged.logLik p x (μ,σ) ((∀ i, |x i-μ| ≤ ρ) → Tendsto f atTop (𝓝 (-(n : ℝ)*log (2*ρ) - k*exp (-eulerMascheroniConstant)))) ∧ ((∃ i, ρ < |x i-μ|) → Tendsto f atTop atBot)
dossier_scope_note: Likelihood path at fixed mean. Finite versus boundary dominance is a separate comparison.

statement: The unrestricted problem is unbounded. In the fitted domain constants collapse and on nonconstant data the compact profile decides exactly against the range uniform.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: (hn : 0 < n) (x : Fin n → ℝ) : let V := TwoPieceGED.freeSdValues x univ (¬ BddAbove {L : ℝ | ∃ ν μ σ : ℝ, 0 < ν ∧ 0 < σ ∧ L = Ged.logLik ν x (μ, σ)}) ∧ (¬ LocationScale.Nonconstant x → ¬ BddAbove V) ∧ (LocationScale.Nonconstant x → ∃ l r : Fin n, (∀ i, x l ≤ x i ∧ x i ≤ x r) ∧ let K := Icc 1 (TwoPieceGED.uniformCutoff n) ×ˢ Icc (x l) (x r) let F := -(n : ℝ) * log (x r - x l) ∃ y ∈ K, IsMaxOn (TwoPieceGED.freeSdProfile x) K y ∧ ((∃ L, IsGreatest V L) ↔ F ≤ TwoPieceGED.freeSdProfile x y) ∧ (TwoPieceGED.freeSdProfile x y < F → IsLUB V F))

statement: All-zero residuals give collapse, otherwise a stationary shape or a compact search endpoint must reach the centered uniform.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: (hn : 0 < n) (x : Fin n → ℝ) (μ : ℝ) : let V := TwoPieceGED.freeSdValues x ({μ} : Set ℝ) let f := fun p ↦ TwoPieceGED.freeSdProfile x (p,μ) let P := TwoPieceGED.uniformCutoff n ((∀ i, x i = μ) → ¬ BddAbove V) ∧ ((∃ i, x i ≠ μ) → BddAbove V ∧ ∃ i : Fin n, (∀ j, |x j-μ| ≤ |x i-μ|) ∧ let F := -(n : ℝ)*log (2*|x i-μ|) let S := {p ∈ Icc 1 P | p = 1 ∨ p = P ∨ deriv f p = 0} DifferentiableOn ℝ f (Ioi 0) ∧ ((∃ L, IsGreatest V L) ↔ ∃ p ∈ S, F ≤ f p) ∧ ((∀ p ∈ S, f p < F) → IsLUB V F))
dossier_scope_note: The statement gives the exact retained-candidate comparison. Finiteness of the stationary root set and generic winner separation are separate.

statement: All-zero residuals give scale collapse. A nonzero residual makes every vanishing-width path lose, uniformly over skew.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: (hn : 0 < n) (x : Fin n → ℝ) (μ : ℝ) : ((∃ i, x i ≠ μ) → ∀ {ι : Type*} {l : Filter ι} {u w : ι → ℝ}, Tendsto u l atTop → (∀ᶠ t in l, w t ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1) → Tendsto (fun t ↦ heldMeanSkew x μ (w t) (u t)) l atBot) ∧ ((∀ i, x i = μ) → ∀ w ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1, Tendsto (heldMeanSkew x μ w) atTop atTop)
dossier_scope_note: Width is inverse total kernel width. Half-normal comparisons are separate.

statement: Constants give unbounded likelihood. Without finite attainment on nonconstant data, an extreme half-normal trace gives the supremum.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: (hn : 0 < n) (x : Fin n → ℝ) : (¬ LocationScale.Nonconstant x → ¬ BddAbove (allFreeValues x)) ∧ (LocationScale.Nonconstant x → (¬ ∃ L, IsGreatest (allFreeValues x) L) → ∃ (i : Fin n) (left : Bool), (if left then ∀ j, x j ≤ x i else ∀ j, x i ≤ x j) ∧ IsLUB (allFreeValues x) (halfLogLik x (x i) (sqrt (endpointSquares x (x i) / n))))

statement: Both compatible half-normal faces have the exact contact penalty and both unsupported faces lose.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: (x : Fin n → ℝ) (μ : ℝ) {σ : ℝ} (hσ : 0 < σ) (left : Bool) : let y := if left then fun i ↦ -x i else x let m := if left then -μ else μ let H := 1 - halfMean^2 let b := σ / sqrt H let z := m - halfMean*b let C := halfLogLik y z b - ((Finset.univ.filter fun i ↦ y i = z).card : ℝ) * (halfMean^2/(8*H^2)) let L := 𝓝[Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1] (if left then 1 else 0) ((∀ i, z ≤ y i) → Tendsto (heldMeanSd x μ σ) L (𝓝 C)) ∧ ((∃ i, y i < z) → Tendsto (heldMeanSd x μ σ) L atBot)
dossier_scope_note: Likelihood boundary traces with both moments retained.

statement: A finite maximizing skew exists exactly when a stationary skew reaches every feasible penalized half trace.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: (x : Fin n → ℝ) (μ : ℝ) {σ : ℝ} (hσ : 0 < σ) : let f := heldMeanSd x μ σ let y := fun (left : Bool) ↦ if left then fun i ↦ -x i else x let H := 1 - halfMean^2 let b := σ / sqrt H let z := fun (left : Bool) ↦ (if left then -μ else μ) - halfMean*b let C := fun (left : Bool) ↦ halfLogLik (y left) (z left) b - ((Finset.univ.filter fun i ↦ y left i = z left).card : ℝ) * (halfMean^2/(8*H^2)) (∃ w ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1, IsMaxOn f (Ioo 0 1) w) ↔ ∃ w ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1, deriv f w = 0 ∧ ∀ left : Bool, (∀ i, z left ≤ y left i) → C left ≤ f w
dossier_scope_note: An algebraic decomposition of the finite stationary set remains open.

statement: The finite maximizing graph comprises all interior minimizing modes with profiled parameters. The replicated symmetric sample gives two distinct actual finite fits.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: (hn : 0 < n) (x : Fin n → ℝ) : let M := fun {k : ℕ} (y : Fin k → ℝ) (c w s : ℝ) ↦ w ∈ Ioo 0 1 ∧ 0 < s ∧ ∀ (d v t : ℝ), v ∈ Ioo 0 1 → 0 < t → heldSkew y v (d,t) ≤ heldSkew y w (c,s) (∀ c w s, M x c w s ↔ LocationScale.Nonconstant x ∧ IsMinOn (modeProfile x) univ c ∧ w ∈ Ioo 0 1 ∧ w = modeFraction x c ∧ s = sqrt (modeProfile x c / n)) ∧ (∃ c w w' s s', c ≠ 0 ∧ M reflectedSample c w s ∧ M reflectedSample (-c) w' s')

statement: At held subunit shape the asymmetric location loss is minimized exactly at the least-loss sample knots.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {ν w : ℝ} (hν : 0 < ν) (hν' : ν < 1) (hw : w ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1) (hn : 0 < n) (x : Fin n → ℝ) (m : ℝ) : IsMinOn (loss x ν w) univ m ↔ ∃ i, m = x i ∧ ∀ j, loss x ν w (x i) ≤ loss x ν w (x j)

statement: At shape one the weighted count inequalities characterize all minimizing locations.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: (hn : 0 < n) (x : Fin n → ℝ) {w : ℝ} (hw : w ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1) (m : ℝ) : IsMinOn (loss x 1 w) univ m ↔ ((Finset.univ.filter fun i ↦ x i < m).card : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) * w ∧ (n : ℝ) * w ≤ ((Finset.univ.filter fun i ↦ x i ≤ m).card : ℝ)

statement: The complete fixed-width maximizing set is a singleton, the weighted median set, or the least-loss knots according to shape.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: (hn : 0 < n) (x : Fin n → ℝ) {p w s : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (hw : w ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1) (hs : 0 < s) : let M := {c | IsMaxOn (fun d ↦ fixedSkewLogLik x p w (d,s)) univ c} (1 < p → ∃ c, M = {c}) ∧ (p = 1 → M = {c | ((Finset.univ.filter fun i ↦ x i < c).card : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) * w ∧ (n : ℝ) * w ≤ ((Finset.univ.filter fun i ↦ x i ≤ c).card : ℝ)}) ∧ (p < 1 → M = {c | ∃ i, c = x i ∧ ∀ j, loss x p w (x i) ≤ loss x p w (x j)})
dossier_scope_note: Positive held shape and skew turn held sd into a fixed total width.

statement: Constants collapse. On nonconstant data all maximizing modes share an explicit profiled width, and are classified in all three shape regimes.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: (hn : 0 < n) (x : Fin n → ℝ) {p w : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (hw : w ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1) : let M := {cs ∈ LocationScale.domain | IsMaxOn (fixedSkewLogLik x p w) LocationScale.domain cs} (¬ LocationScale.Nonconstant x → M = ∅) ∧ (LocationScale.Nonconstant x → ∃ s > 0, (∀ c, IsMinOn (loss x p w) univ c → s = (p * loss x p w c / n)^p⁻¹) ∧ (1 < p → ∃ c, M = {c} ×ˢ {s}) ∧ (p = 1 → M = {c | ((Finset.univ.filter fun i ↦ x i < c).card : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) * w ∧ (n : ℝ) * w ≤ ((Finset.univ.filter fun i ↦ x i ≤ c).card : ℝ)} ×ˢ {s}) ∧ (p < 1 → M = {c | ∃ i, c = x i ∧ ∀ j, loss x p w (x i) ≤ loss x p w (x j)} ×ˢ {s}))

statement: Any nonzero held-mean residual rules out vanishing total width even if skew degenerates. All-zero residuals admit unbounded collapse.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: (hn : 0 < n) (x : Fin n → ℝ) (μ : ℝ) {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) : ((∃ i, x i ≠ μ) → ∀ {ι : Type*} {l : Filter ι} {u w : ι → ℝ}, Tendsto u l atTop → (∀ᶠ t in l, w t ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1) → Tendsto (fun t ↦ heldMeanSkew x μ p (w t) (u t)) l atBot) ∧ ((∀ i, x i = μ) → ∀ w ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1, Tendsto (heldMeanSkew x μ p w) atTop atTop)
dossier_scope_note: The two positive-width half faces are outside this collapse theorem.

statement: Constants collapse. On nonconstant data, attainment is equivalent to a finite witness meeting the range uniform, which is the supremum when all finite values are lower.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: (hn : 0 < n) (x : Fin n → ℝ) {w : ℝ} (hw : w ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1) : let V := {L : ℝ | ∃ p c s : ℝ, 1 ≤ p ∧ 0 < s ∧ L = freeShapeLogLik x w p c s} (¬ LocationScale.Nonconstant x → ¬ BddAbove V) ∧ (LocationScale.Nonconstant x → ∃ l r : Fin n, (∀ i, x l ≤ x i ∧ x i ≤ x r) ∧ let F := -(n : ℝ) * log (x r - x l) ((∃ L, IsGreatest V L) ↔ ∃ L ∈ V, F ≤ L) ∧ ((∀ L ∈ V, L < F) → IsLUB V F))
dossier_scope_note: The likelihood height comparison uses a strict shape cutoff.

statement: Both width ends and the finite stationary comparison are joined in held-mean coordinates, including sharp collapse heights and the complete stationary maximizing set.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: (hn : 0 < n) (x : Fin n → ℝ) (μ ν w : ℝ) (hν : 2 < ν) (hw : w ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1) : let e := halfMoment ν * (1 - 2*w) let f := logAlongAtom x μ ν w e let E := TDist.exponent x μ ν let C := collapseLogHeight x μ ν w e let R := {u : ℝ | 0 < u ∧ scaleScore x μ ν w e u = 0} Tendsto f (𝓝[>] 0) atBot ∧ (¬ BddAbove (f '' Ioi 0) ↔ E < 0) ∧ (E < 0 → Tendsto f atTop atTop) ∧ (0 < E → Tendsto f atTop atBot) ∧ (E = 0 → Tendsto f atTop (𝓝 C) ∧ Tendsto (fun u ↦ exp (f u)) atTop (𝓝 (exp C))) ∧ ((∃ u ∈ Ioi (0 : ℝ), IsMaxOn f (Ioi 0) u) ↔ ∃ u ∈ R, 0 < E ∨ E = 0 ∧ C ≤ f u) ∧ R.Finite ∧ {u ∈ Ioi (0 : ℝ) | IsMaxOn f (Ioi 0) u} = {u ∈ R | (0 < E ∨ E = 0 ∧ C ≤ f u) ∧ ∀ v ∈ R, f v ≤ f u}
dossier_scope_note: The almost-everywhere cardinality claim requires a separate proof.

statement: On outward residuals, including all unit-skew samples, there is a unique finite maximizer exactly for positive collapse exponent. At critical count the collapse height is unattained.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: (hn : 0 < n) (x : Fin n → ℝ) (μ ν w : ℝ) (hν : 2 < ν) (hw : w ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1) (hout : ∀ i, (x i - μ) * (halfMoment ν * (1 - 2 * w)) ≥ 0) : let f := logAlongAtom x μ ν w (halfMoment ν * (1 - 2*w)) let E := TDist.exponent x μ ν let C := collapseLogHeight x μ ν w (halfMoment ν * (1 - 2*w)) ((∃! u, 0 < u ∧ IsMaxOn f (Ioi 0) u) ↔ 0 < E) ∧ (E ≤ 0 → StrictMonoOn f (Ioi 0)) ∧ (E = 0 → IsLUB (f '' Ioi 0) C ∧ ∀ u > 0, f u < C)
dossier_scope_note: The directional hypothesis restricts this cardinality theorem.

statement: A critical supporting sample extreme gives a finite unattained joint supremum.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: (hn : 0 < n) (x : Fin n → ℝ) (y ν w : ℝ) (hν : 2 < ν) (hw : w ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1) (hE : TDist.exponent x y ν = 0) (left : Bool) (hs : if left then (∀ i, x i ≤ y) ∧ 1-w ≤ w else (∀ i, y ≤ x i) ∧ w ≤ 1-w) : let W := if left then w else 1-w let C := collapseLogHeight x y ν w 0 let V := {L : ℝ | ∃ c u : ℝ, 0 < u ∧ L = logAlongAtom x y ν w ((y-c)*u) u} C = TDist.collapseLogValue x y ν + n*log (2*W) ∧ IsLUB V C ∧ ∀ L ∈ V, L < C
dossier_scope_note: Both orientations are included. The sample must lie on the broad side for this critical extreme comparison.

statement: A critical supporting sample extreme gives a finite unattained joint supremum.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: (hn : 0 < n) (x : Fin n → ℝ) (y ν : ℝ) (hν : 2 < ν) (hE : TDist.exponent x y ν = 0) (left : Bool) (hs : if left then ∀ i, x i ≤ y else ∀ i, y ≤ x i) : let C := TDist.collapseLogValue x y ν + n * log 2 let V := {L : ℝ | ∃ c u w : ℝ, 0 < u ∧ w ∈ Ioo 0 1 ∧ L = logAlongAtom x y ν w ((y-c)*u) u} IsLUB V C ∧ ∀ L ∈ V, L < C
dossier_scope_note: Both orientations are included. The finite and two-sided width domain is compared against the critical extreme limit.
